title: Resend tags + new reminder subject lines have no test — spec requires tags on every applicant email
evidence:
[#("template", "application_reminder_2"), #("vacancy_id", vacancy_id)],

and the stage-2 subject at email_client.gleam:530-533:
  let subject =
    property_name
    <> " \u{2014} applications close "
    <> format_close_date(closes_on)
detail: All four applicant emails gained tags (a spec acceptance criterion) and both reminder subjects are new, but email_client_test.gleam exercises only pure HTML builders/format_close_date/tracked_application_url — grep shows no subject or tags test. A malformed tags JSON shape or bad subject fails only at runtime.
recommended_fix: Extract the Resend request-body builder (and subject selection) into a pure function and unit-test the tags array shape plus both new reminder subject lines.

title: data-section-id SSR emission on all 8 form sections is untested — section funnel degrades silently if ids are missing or collide
detail: The JS section funnel keys entirely off these server-rendered attributes, yet grep for "data-section-id" across server/test returns zero assertions. The JS tests use synthetic DOM, so a typo or duplicate id in the real SSR output (the exact bug the numeric attrs had) ships undetected.
recommended_fix: Add a form_view_test asserting the rendered application page contains all eight unique data-section-id values (about_you … review_consent).

title: Stage-1 self-heal clear (clear_reminder_for_sender) has zero tests, and the new 10-minute freshness window on both clears is unpinned
evidence:
UPDATE inbound_email
SET reminder_sent_at = NULL
WHERE vacancy_id = $1
  AND lower(sender_email) = lower($2)
  AND reminder_sent_at > now() - interval '10 minutes'
detail: grep shows no test references clear_reminder_for_sender at all; clear_followup_for_sender is tested only against a fresh stamp (followup_clear_rearms_a_failed_send_test). The 10-minute window — added to stop clears nulling OLD stamps and re-arming duplicate reminders — has no aged-stamp negative test on either stage.
recommended_fix: Add integration tests: clear with a stamp older than 10 minutes must be a no-op (both stages), plus a stage-1 clear-then-re-mark happy path mirroring the stage-2 test.

title: Send-failure → stamp-clear self-heal wiring is exercised but never asserted
detail: The claimed self-healing (a failed Resend send clears that enquirer's stamp) is only proven at the SQL level; the wiring from a send error outcome to the clear call runs in a spawned process against an empty key with no assertion, so a regression there (e.g. clearing the wrong stage's stamp) would pass CI.
recommended_fix: Extract the per-outcome error handling from send_reminders_background into a named, testable function and unit-test that an Error outcome invokes the matching stage's clear.

title: apply_analytics.js initBrowser DOM wiring (IntersectionObserver, visibilitychange/pagehide/pageshow, submit latch listener) untested at any level
detail: The pure state machines are well tested via node --test, but the wiring that feeds them — listener registration, the submit latch, bfcache re-arm, consent-event listener, marker reads — has no executed test. A wiring typo silently kills the funnel with no failure anywhere.
recommended_fix: Add a light DOM-level test (happy-dom/jsdom or a bug-hunt E2E scenario) that loads the page, submits, and asserts the latch suppresses abandonment; or extract wiring into injectable functions.

title: Anonymous-id consent lifecycle in the inline PostHog snippet is only string-pinned, never executed
detail: The snippet's new logic (reuse id only while RTConsent grants analytics, drop stored id when consent unknown, persist get_distinct_id() fallback, remove on withdrawal) is asserted via string-contains on the rendered HTML. Behavioral bugs that preserve those substrings — wrong branch order, swapped persist/remove — would still pass.
recommended_fix: Extract the snippet's id-store logic into apply_analytics.js (already node-tested) or add a node --test case evaluating the snippet against fake RTConsent/localStorage.

title: Two-stage reminder toast copy matrix in client.gleam has no test
evidence:
0, 1 -> "Follow-up's on its way to one person."
            0, m ->
              "Follow-ups on their way to " <> int.to_string(m) <> " people."
            n, m ->
              "Reminders on their way to "
detail: The six-arm #(reminded, followup) toast matrix is inline in update_inner and untestable as written; the button label matrix was extracted and tested but the post-send confirmation copy was not. Wrong-count or wrong-stage copy would reach landlords unchecked.
recommended_fix: Extract the toast message selection into a public pure function (like reminder_button_label) and unit-test the six arms.

title: "Followed up ✓" awaiting-row badge precedence (followed_up over reminded) untested
detail: The three-way badge case (Followed up ✓ / Reminded ✓ / awaiting) lives in private view_row; the new client test file covers only reminder_button_label. A pattern-order regression would mislabel rows and no test would fail.
recommended_fix: Extract the badge label selection into a public function and add unit tests for the three states, or assert via a rendered-view test.

title: clear_rejected_stamps path (invalid legacy sender un-stamped inside the transaction) untested
detail: The new defence-in-depth branch — a marked row whose address fails send-time validation gets its stamp cleared in the same transaction — has no test seeding an invalid legacy sender through the remind handler. A regression wedges malformed-address enquirers out of the series silently.
recommended_fix: Add an integration test seeding a sender_email that fails is_valid_email, call the remind handler, and assert the stamp was cleared and the address excluded from recipients.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100%: submit/spam/error/duplicate disambiguation (JS outcomeEvent tests + SSR marker tests), consent-gated queue, two-stage mark/count/list gates, one-shot, re-enquiry restart, applied-exclusion, cross-tenant 404 all covered. P1 ≈80–85%: three narrow NONE gaps — Resend tags/subjects envelope, data-section-id SSR emission, stage-1 clear + 10-min window. Overall ≈85–90% across all behaviour changes.
recommended_fix: Raise to PASS by adding: tags/subject envelope unit tests, an 8-unique-data-section-id SSR assertion, and aged-stamp (>10 min) clear no-op integration tests for both stages.
